name: The Veiled
source:
"There’s no reason to serve gods who have long since been dead."

The Veiled One has spent her entire life in silence and solitude, destined for a life ending in sacrifice. What will a sister of the convent do, once the Veiled One suddenly breaks that vow to the gods?

The Veiled is a story about those whose autonomy is lost for the benefit of others. When callous truths are unveiled, will one despair, seek solace in ignorance, uphold the cycle, or resist?

[From [url=https://cmangos.itch.io/the-veiled]itch.io[/url]]
